lesson: The short entry failed because it ignored the weekly RSI oversold condition, leading to a liquidity trap despite the bearish EMA alignment. The system incorrectly prioritized trend-following momentum over mean-reversion signals in a low-volatility environment.
adjustment: Require a confirmed break and retest of a 15m structural support level before entering shorts when the weekly RSI is below 30.
methodology_flag: Trust EMA trend-following less on XRP when weekly RSI is oversold.
